You are playing a text adventure game. I will describe what you can perceive in the game. You write the single action you want to take in the game starting with >. Write your plan for your next actions on the line below your action, starting with "Next actions:".
For example:
> open cupboard
Next actions: take orange, eat orange

You can have up to two objects in your inventory at the same time.

Your goal for this game is: Put the banana in the freezer, the book on the side table and the plate on the table.

Once you have achieved your goal, write "> done" to end the game.

You are in a broom closet now. There are a mop and a broom. The mop is on the floor. The broom is on the floor. There is a passage to a hallway here.

Next time: drop an item before taking the banana, then proceed to the freezer. Keep inventory management simple—only carry what's needed for the goal.
-
 I failed. I got stuck trying to take the plate while my inventory was full (mop and broom). I should have dropped one item first, then taken the plate. Next time, I will manage inventory by dropping unnecessary items before picking up goal objects.
-

Should have ignored the wardrobe after confirming its contents, moved to the hallway to search for the required objects (sandwich, plate, mop, freezer, shelf, table). Next time: immediately explore other rooms after finding no useful items.
